CJP Spokesperson Meets Government Ministers Amidst Reports of Disagreement

CJP spokesperson Saurav Das met with Union Ministers JP Nadda and Jitendra Singh, with reports suggesting potential disagreements between CJP and activist Sonam Wangchuk. Das addressed these reports, stating that discussions with the ministers were ongoing. The profiles of CJP spokespersons Saurav Das and Abhishek Ranka were also highlighted, noting their educational backgrounds.
